messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Bifactor plot from a mirt model
parts:
I had plans to add something like the lavaanPlot package to mirt since I like the DiagrammR package's output, but sadly this is rather low on the priority list .... Building such diagrams is not really difficult, but at this time it's a little tedious as the model information need to be extracted via functions like coef(), extract.mirt(), etc. Pull requests are welcome for this type of feature :) 

Phil


On Mon, Aug 12, 2024 at 1:17 AM zha...@gmail.com <zhao...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all,

I am wondering if anyone has experience plotting a path diagram from a bifactor mirt model? I like the layout from lavaanPlot and I am wondering if there is any way to convert a mirt object to a lavaan object?

There is a function in the sirt package that converts from lavaan to mirt but I have no luck finding a function that does the other way around.

Any suggestions would be much appreciated!
